_doc: Level-1 control-plane / captain state. Point: EPIC. Location: <repo>/plans/fleet/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<epic>/state.json (RELATIVE to the project repo root, committed to that repo -- NOT ~/.pi). Captain tracks DAG-dependency tree + resume: computes runnable-set (DAG whose dependsOn all passed AND not in failedDags), spawns orchestrator per-DAG + judge post-DAG. Pure DAG execution (no barrier sync). Technical issues NEVER reach here (orchestrator handles those). Design ref: pi config docs/design/2026-07-03-fleet-dag-rework.md.
_instantiate: Planner fills runName, baseBranch, integrationBranch, phases, and dags[] (each DAG: dependsOn + failureTolerance + orchestratorModel + thinking + assignment safety-ratchet). Captain updates dagStatus/failedDags/stopFlag/knowledge + per-DAG judge blocks at runtime.

branchStrategy._doc: Ditetapkan SEKALI di planning (auto-deteksi + konfirmasi user 1x), dipakai seluruh run. Resume anchor — jangan lupa base branch.
branchStrategy._integration_enum: auto-push (trunk: merge+push base tiap DAG passed) | pr-mr (classic / trunk-no-flag-opt-out: kumpulkan -> PR/MR ke base)
branchStrategy._promotedRule_doc: nama .pi/rules yg dibuat dari keputusan ini (mis 'fleet-branch-strategy'), atau null kalau user tak promote

prTooling._doc: Probe di planning saat integration=pr-mr. PR/MR CLI TIDAK wajib. Gagal runtime -> selalu fallback url-mode, jangan block.
prTooling._prToolReady_doc: true kalau CLI ada + auth proper
prTooling._prMode_enum: cli (auto-bikin PR/MR) | url (print URL utk bikin manual di step akhir)

dags._dependsOn_doc: DAG murni (dependency-only, no barrier). Captain: DAG runnable ⟺ semua dependsOn berstatus passed DAN tak ada di failedDags.
dags._thinking_doc: per-DAG reasoning effort level (mis 'high'/'medium'/'low'), planner map by kompleksitas

assignment._default_mapping: low -> implementer-critical + deep-reviewer ; standard -> implementer + reviewer ; trivial -> implementer-lite + reviewer
assignment._ratchet: tier order implementer-lite<implementer<implementer-critical ; reviewer<deep-reviewer. Orchestrator may UPGRADE effective>=planned, NEVER downgrade. Resume reads effective*, no re-judgment, no silent-downgrade.

judge._doc: BARU — gate DAG (judge post-DAG, Opus, state-file-only, AUTHORITY).
judge._attempt_doc: bounded 2x — judge fail -> orchestrator perbaiki -> gagal lagi -> captain mark DAG failed

dagStatus._doc: Status per-DAG (resume anchor). Captain recompute runnable-set setiap perubahan status.

<dagId>._level2_doc: pointer ke L2 orchestrator state file

_failedDags_doc: captain scan: skip any DAG that depends on a failed DAG. If no runnable DAG remains -> fleet stop.
_knowledge_doc: Accumulated knowledge[] across DAGs (seedKnowledge + per-DAG knowledgeDelta). Reloaded on resume. Durable items also persisted to .pi/rules via writeKnowledge().

stopFlag._doc: Captain STOPs fleet when a hard-dependency dies and dependents cannot proceed (blocked-hard) / no runnable DAG remains. Technical ambiguity does NOT stop fleet -- orchestrator decides + records assumption.
